meta.what: official FastWAM .pt video tower -> wan22_5b Orbax tree (this repo's NNX names)
meta.note: torch Linear weight is (out,in) and flax kernel is (in,out), hence transpose(1,0) on every 2-D weight; patch_embedding is a Conv3d and takes maxdiffusion's (2,3,4,1,0). The action tower has the SAME per-block key template at width 1024 and is NOT in this table - it has no counterpart in the Wan2.2 base tree.
